proof_body:
by
  intro p t hp hq
  have hnn : 0 ≤ (1 - (p : ℝ)) * Real.exp t := mul_nonneg (by linarith [p.2.2]) (Real.exp_pos t).le
  have h1 : HasSum (fun n : ℕ => (1 - (p : ℝ)) ^ n * (p : ℝ) * Real.exp (t * (n : ℝ))) ((p : ℝ) / (1 - (1 - (p : ℝ)) * Real.exp t)) := by
    have := (hasSum_geometric_of_lt_one hnn hq).mul_left (p : ℝ)
    rw [div_eq_mul_inv]
    refine Eq.mpr (congrArg (fun f : ℕ → ℝ => HasSum f _) (funext fun n => ?_)) this
    rw [mul_comm t, Real.exp_nat_mul, mul_pow]; ring
  have hint : MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun n : ℕ => Real.exp (t * (n : ℝ))) (ProbabilityTheory.geometricMeasure p) := by
    rw [ProbabilityTheory.integrable_geometricMeasure_iff hp]
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)] using h1.summable
  refine ⟨hint, ?_⟩
  have h2 := ProbabilityTheory.hasSum_integral_geometricMeasure hp hint
  simp only [smul_eq_mul] at h2
  exact h2.unique h1
target_source: ∀ (p : unitInterval) (t : ℝ), p ≠ 0 → (1 - (p : ℝ)) * Real.exp t < 1 → MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun n : ℕ => Real.exp (t * (n : ℝ))) (ProbabilityTheory.geometricMeasure p) ∧ ProbabilityTheory.mgf (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℝ)) (ProbabilityTheory.geometricMeasure p) t = (p : ℝ) / (1 - (1 - (p : ℝ)) * Real.exp t)
